from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted citation data for one provided paper."""
    paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being processed")
    referenced_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers found in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates citation data from all provided papers."""
    paper_records: list[PaperCitationRecord]
